name: lisa-original-reading-retell-designer
description: Create illustration-first retell worksheets by generating source-grounded characters, events, props, and locations before worksheet assembly.

interface.longDescription: A visual-first teaching design skill that derives locked characters and story facts from reading materials, generates and checks the complete illustration system first, then builds visually rich scaffolded retell worksheets with teaching and visual QA.
capabilities: Create visually rich scaffolded retell worksheets
defaultPrompt: Generate source-grounded characters and story illustrations first, then build them into a visually rich scaffolded retell worksheet.
Do not start worksheet assembly until the complete visual asset family passes Visual QA.
